limitations: The full enhancement goal remains active and incomplete; these are experimental candidates.

Overworld shiny palette selection remains incomplete. Active native object params have the shiny bit set and battle/data shininess is true, but observed field sprites retain ordinary colors. Palette correction and sparkle remain required.

Runtime evidence covers ordinary grass Hoothoot/Rattata and native/1-64/Always settings. Full starter/gift, egg/trade exclusions, additional species/forms/abilities and newly released roamer adaptation/gameplay remain pending.
Four guarded creation calls are targeted. Other fixed/preset/egg/trade/trainer/UI/native roamer paths stay byte-identical; this does not claim every scripted special Pokemon receives boosted odds.
Boosted labels are nominal roll-count equivalents, not exact reciprocal or independent statistical guarantees. Native Cute Charm already has a special original PID distribution.

Menu/contact runs have no RAM fixtures. Capture supply is one declared four-byte native Poke Ball slot before battle setup; descendant native saves inherit it. No Pokemon, PID, HP, EXP or story values are seeded.
The empty-bag and late-supply runs are diagnostic setup observations, not successful capture tests. They are excluded from the accepted-run count.
HG entered another shiny contact battle after native saving; no action was taken there. The saved caught party and settings were independently verified by cold reload.
All saves are isolated project-created copies, including HG-derived SS progress; they do not establish a fresh SS story or general save interchangeability.
Cave/water visible models, legendary sprites, other unfinished inventory features and hardware acceptance remain pending.
